title: "[FEATURE] "

## Feature Description
Clearly describe the new feature, guide, or content you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem or gap does this address?
- Is there an existing guide that's incomplete?
- Is there a Git/GitHub topic not covered?
- What difficulty level would benefit from this?

## Proposed Solution
How would you implement this?
- Outline the structure (e.g., sections, subsections)
- Suggest examples or diagrams
- What format? (new guide, new section, update to existing)

## Use Cases
Who would benefit from this feature?
- Beginners learning Git
- Developers transitioning from another VCS
- Teams setting up workflows
- Other: ___

## Additional Context
- Links to similar resources
- Any relevant discussion or feedback
- Priority level (low, medium, high)
